The only change deletes a four-line comment above `CONFIG_HISTORY_LIMIT` and `CONFIG_HISTORY_PAGES` ([L6367-L6368](https://github.com/melodic-software/claude-code-plugins/blob/bd481d27e70ce2d696c989cc91ea045a63b81eda/plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_merge_policy.py#L6367-L6368)).
